title: How and Why Datadog moved from cloud-managed to self-managed Postgres
by: Nick Canzoneri, Datadog, at PGConf NYC 2025
summary: Slides from a talk on why a company running hundreds of Postgres clusters across several clouds left managed services for its own Postgres platform on Kubernetes, how it moved a whole region, and what got better and worse. The stack is Patroni (with ZooKeeper for leader election), WAL-G backups, a Helm chart rather than an operator, and Temporal workflows for automation. Useful before you weigh RDS-style convenience against running Postgres yourself.
